items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: The interviewee does not speak about Bix Beiderbecke in the provided context; the interviewer mentions Bix in the context of Red Nichols being a copier of him.

ctx.x: None of that was... He tried to copy off Big Spiderback, you know what I mean? That's what you tried to do. You never used to like that, remember you? Still do. Used to like that.

Still do. Greatest trumpet player that ever lived. I see him. Don't tell me this sometime, eh? No, he does. He died when he was 29, 1929. That's Red Nichols. Red Nichols, yeah. Another one they tried to copy. Yeah. But Red, I think he's the worst copier of all. Who? Here Red Nichols is the worst copier of Bix. Bix has got some imitators that are terrific.
